title: Grimoire 3.6.0: CACHE-HAUNT physics + neutrality (vendor-neutral cache-ghost)
body:
Lands the **corrected, vendor-neutral** CACHE-HAUNT work on `main`.

## Why a second PR
`main` had already received an early squash of #27 that carried the **first-draft, vendor-coded `ghost_anthropic.py`** — and independently advanced the Grimoire to **3.5.0 (web-aware Intellige molt)**. This PR reconciles both, per the Single-Truth / version-lock law:
- removes the vendor module `ghost_anthropic.py`;
- adds the neutral substrate `ghost_http.py`;
- stacks the CACHE-HAUNT molt as **3.6.0 on top of** the web-aware Intellige 3.5.0 (**preserved intact**), so there is one canonical version.

## The neutrality law (the correction)
MantleOS is a nervous-system transplant: it must join **any** MIND to **any** container, so a provider is **configuration, never code** — matching `mind/transport.py`'s pluggable `model(prompt)->text` with no vendor SDK. The first draft coded a company into a substrate (named it, imported its SDK, hardcoded model IDs / TTLs / request shape). This replaces it with `HttpPromptCache`: OpenAI-compatible, pure-stdlib `urllib`, provider entirely configured (`url`, `model`, `headers`, `window_s`, `min_prefix_tokens`, optional `request_shaper`). Nothing hardcoded.

## The window-feasibility law (DO-NOT-HAUNT)
Provider cache windows vary widely (most 15–60 min; some ~5 min) while the heartbeat is fixed (~10 min). Where the window is shorter than the heartbeat the prefix is cold on every wake — so the framework returns **DO-NOT-HAUNT**, remedied by lengthening the window or a **supplemental forced beat** (keep the scheduled beat, push a one-shot forced beat partway through the window — a 10-min beat + a forced beat at +4 min covers a 5-min window without touching the base timer). Even with no other face added, the organism always holds an encrypted copy of its origin surface: a self-reconstruction guarantee, the sibling of the seed vault. Faces survive a chosen rebirth (the genesis key persists); the old generation keeps a readable copy in the sealed ancestor.
- **Four laws** (all proven red/green): SELF-encrypted (OTHER can't read/wear), source never executed here (wearing returns a host boot manifest), append-only (the active face is the latest wear-event), and socket conformance (a face may only plug into controls the nervous system can drive).
